subject: math
title: Place value to millions and thousandths
titleId: Nilai tempat sampai jutaan dan perseribuan
canDo: I can read, write, compare and order numbers to millions and to three decimal places.

subject: math
title: Rounding whole numbers and decimals
canDo: I can round whole numbers and decimals, and use rounding to estimate.

subject: math
title: Multiplying and dividing decimals by 10, 100 and 1,000
titleId: Mengali dan membagi desimal dengan 10, 100, dan 1.000
canDo: I can multiply and divide decimals by 10, 100 and 1,000 and convert between units.

subject: math
title: Sequences and position-to-term rules
titleId: Barisan dan aturan posisi ke suku
canDo: I can use term-to-term and position-to-term rules and spot special number sequences.

subject: math
title: Function machines and simple equations
canDo: I can use function machines and find the unknown number in a simple equation.

subject: math
title: Calculating with negative numbers
canDo: I can add and subtract with negative numbers and find differences across zero.

subject: math
title: Order of operations
canDo: I can use the order of operations, including brackets, to work out calculations.

subject: math
title: Factors, multiples and primes
canDo: I can find common factors and common multiples and break a number into prime factors.

subject: math
title: Square numbers, cube numbers and roots
canDo: I can work with square numbers, cube numbers and square roots.

subject: math
title: Adding and subtracting large numbers and decimals
titleId: Penjumlahan dan pengurangan bilangan besar dan desimal
canDo: I can add and subtract large numbers and decimals in my head or in columns.

subject: math
title: Multiplying by 2-digit numbers
canDo: I can multiply a number with up to 4 digits by a 2-digit number.

subject: math
title: Dividing by 2-digit numbers
canDo: I can divide by a 2-digit number and write a remainder as a whole number, a fraction or a decimal.

subject: math
title: Simplifying and comparing fractions
canDo: I can simplify fractions and compare fractions with different denominators.

subject: math
title: Adding and subtracting fractions and mixed numbers
titleId: Penjumlahan dan pengurangan pecahan dan pecahan campuran
canDo: I can add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with different denominators.

subject: math
title: Multiplying and dividing fractions
canDo: I can multiply and divide a fraction by a whole number and solve fraction problems.

subject: math
title: Multiplying and dividing decimals
canDo: I can multiply and divide decimals by whole numbers.

subject: math
title: Fractions, decimals and percentages
canDo: I can change between fractions, decimals and percentages and put them in order.

subject: math
title: Percentage problems
canDo: I can find percentages of amounts and solve problems about discounts and increases.

subject: math
title: Ratio, proportion and scale
canDo: I can simplify ratios, share in a ratio and use direct proportion and scale.

subject: math
title: Time, timetables and time zones
canDo: I can work out durations, read timetables and compare times in different time zones.

subject: math
title: Area and perimeter of compound shapes
canDo: I can find missing lengths and the area and perimeter of compound shapes.

subject: math
title: Area of triangles
canDo: I can find the area of a triangle using its base and perpendicular height.

subject: math
title: Volume and capacity of cuboids
canDo: I can find the volume of a cuboid and link cubic centimetres to millilitres.

subject: math
title: Calculating angles
canDo: I can find missing angles on a line, around a point, in triangles and in quadrilaterals.

subject: math
title: Properties of shapes and circles
titleId: Sifat bangun datar, lingkaran, dan bangun ruang
canDo: I can describe quadrilaterals, circles and 3D shapes and recognise their nets.

subject: math
title: Coordinates in four quadrants
canDo: I can read and plot coordinates with negative numbers in all four quadrants.

subject: math
title: Translation, reflection and rotation
canDo: I can translate, reflect and rotate points on a coordinate grid.

subject: math
title: Mean, median, mode and range
canDo: I can find the mean, median, mode and range and use them to compare data.

subject: math
title: Pie charts, line graphs and frequency tables
titleId: Diagram lingkaran, grafik garis, dan tabel frekuensi
canDo: I can read and interpret pie charts, line graphs and grouped frequency tables.

subject: math
title: Probability as a number
canDo: I can write a probability as a fraction, a decimal or a percentage and predict outcomes.
